title: Ctenorhabdatus Capulus
description: A surreal circular artwork features a large glowing turquoise seashell-like capsule at the center with intricate white patterns. To the left is a woman with long pink hair and golden facial markings, while to the right is another woman's face with closed eyes and golden lines, all set against a misty background containing a red-hatted figure, a person with a blue umbrella on a street, and ethereal smoke.
prompt: Surreal circular composition with a glowing turquoise ribbed seashell capsule floating at the center, ornate white patterns on its surface. On the left a beautiful woman with flowing pink hair and golden decorative lines on her face, on the right another woman's serene face with closed eyes and golden markings, misty ethereal background showing a red hooded figure and a person holding a blue umbrella on a foggy street, atmospheric fantasy style with soft smoke and subtle golden details.
